page: Microsoft Azure E2ds_v4 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the EDSv4 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8272CL processor operating at 2.6 GHz, configured with 1 physical core and 2 threads, yielding 2 vCPUs. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX, AVX-512 (including AVX512F and AVX512_VNNI), AES cryptography, and Intel Virtualization Technology (VMX). The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a 77 GB SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable, though it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates that the E2ds_v4 exhibits modest compute and memory performance. In stress-ng testing, single-core performance is weak (bottom 25% tier) at 1403.89, while multi-core performance falls into the poor category (bottom 10%) at 1845.78. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with read-only large block bandwidth at 11.88 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 8.93 GB/sec, both ranking in the bottom 10%. Geekbench testing aligns with these results, showing an average single-core score of 1212.0 but a poor multi-core score of 1477.0. Specialized tasks such as software compilation (1759.0), ray tracing (1578.0), and image processing (1280.0) all register in the bottom 10% tier.

The primary tradeoff of the E2ds_v4 is its low processing throughput and memory bandwidth relative to its generous 16.0 GB memory allocation. While the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require intense CPU calculations, the server struggles with compute-heavy tasks. This is evidenced by a poor Passmark database operations score of 698.6 and a Redis SET throughput of 1.76 million operations per second. Consequently, this instance is best suited for lightweight database caching, small-scale web serving, or memory-intensive but computationally simple background processes rather than high-performance computing, large-scale compilation, or real-time LLM inference.
description: Microsoft Azure E2ds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the EDSv4 family, powered by a dedicated 2.6 GHz Intel Xeon 8272CL processor (x86_64) with 2 vCPUs (1 physical core, 2 threads) and 16.0 GB of RAM. It features a 77 GB local SSD and is Premium Storage capable. Benchmark results show modest compute capabilities, with a single-core Geekbench score of 1212.0 (average) and a multi-core score of 1477.0 (poor). Memory bandwidth is limited, with large-block read speeds at 11.88 GB/sec. Due to its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, the E2ds_v4 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive, low-compute workloads. It is best suited for lightweight database caching, small-scale web serving, and basic memory-bound applications, while being less optimal for CPU-heavy tasks or high-throughput data processing.
